name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $66,810 on 14 Nov, 23% below its high and 11% lower on the week; no stablecoin de-peg found
state: Bitcoin was near $66,810 early on 14 Nov, 22.9% below its 52-week high of $86,600, 11.2% lower on the week and 17.3% lower over a month (Yahoo Finance). The worst day of the past five sessions was a 6.4% fall. The drawdown is nearing but still inside the 25% Watch line, and no stablecoin de-peg or top-10 exchange failure was found as of 14 Nov.
for_you: Crypto prices have fallen steeply this month. Holders are exposed to further large swings; the FCA warns that cryptoassets are high risk and largely unprotected.
rubric_hit: BTC drawdown 22.9% < 25% Watch line; no stablecoin or exchange incident = Normal
why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
